blurb: Vermont Boat Rental offers a fleet of well-maintained boats for day cruises, watersports, and fishing on Lake Champlain. Boats include features like bimini tops for shade, GPS navigation, Bluetooth sound systems, and watersports equipment such as waterskis, wakeboards, and tubes. Rentals are located at the Burlington Community Boathouse and suitable for families and groups.
